name: subgraph-registry-mcp
description: MCP server for agent-friendly subgraph discovery and opt-in querying on The Graph Network. Better search than official subgraph-MCP, real 30-day query volume, contract-first lookup, plus opt-in schema and execute_query. Search/recommend stay discovery and never auto-query. No private key in the package.

scripts.version: node scripts/sync-server-json.js && node scripts/gen-openapi.js && git add server.json openapi.yaml data/openapi.json

author: PaulieB14
